dialogue.content: こんにちは。11時からよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Hello. We're scheduled to start at 11 o'clock. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: I look forward to it too.

dialogue.content: それでは始めます。
dialogue.English: Alright, let's begin.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: こんにちわ
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 初めにあなたの年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 状況が45歳です
dialogue.English: I'm 45 years old.

dialogue.content: 女性です
dialogue.English: I'm female.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 転職先が決まらず悩んでます
dialogue.English: I'm struggling because I can't find a new job.

dialogue.content: それは悩ましいですね
dialogue.English: That must be very worrying.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのような経緯で転職することになったのですか？
dialogue.English: What led you to decide to change jobs?

dialogue.content: 体調がすぐれず転職しました
dialogue.English: I changed jobs because my health wasn't good.

dialogue.content: (転職することにしました)
dialogue.English: (I mean, I decided to change jobs.)

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までの職場ではしんどい思いをされてきたのですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you had a difficult time at your previous workplace.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: これからはもっと楽なところで働きたいですよね
dialogue.English: From now on, you'd like to work somewhere less demanding, right?

dialogue.content: ええできればそうおもいまます
dialogue.English: Yes, if possible, that's what I'm hoping for.

dialogue.content: そうですよね今までは、どんなところがしんどかったですか？
dialogue.English: That's understandable. What aspects of your previous job were particularly difficult for you?

dialogue.content: ２４時間営業なので夜勤がきつかったです
dialogue.English: It was a 24-hour operation, so the night shifts were tough.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね夜勤は身体にこたえますよね
dialogue.English: I see. Night shifts can really take a toll on your body, can't they?

dialogue.content: ええそうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: それで、無理をされて体調を崩されたのですね
dialogue.English: So, you pushed yourself too hard and it ended up affecting your health.

dialogue.content: 今のお身体の具合はいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How is your health now?

dialogue.content: はい　そう思います。大分良くなりました。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so. I'm feeling much better. Thank you for asking.

dialogue.content: そうですか大分良くなったということで安心しました
dialogue.English: I see. I'm relieved to hear that you're feeling much better.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今は転職先が決まらないということですが
dialogue.English: You mentioned you're having trouble finding a new job at the moment.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 候補にあがっている所とかはありますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are there any potential places you're considering?

dialogue.content: 履歴書送っても面接までいかないんです
dialogue.English: Even when I send my resume, I don't get to the interview stage.

dialogue.content: 書類審査が通らないということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you're not passing the initial document screening?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それはがっかりしますよね
dialogue.English: That must be discouraging.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: It is.

dialogue.content: 募集要項とかと照らして問題なくてもなんですか？
dialogue.English: Even when you seem to meet the job requirements?

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: どうしてなんだろう？って思いますよね
dialogue.English: It makes you wonder why, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: ええ本当に、、
dialogue.English: Yes, it really does...

dialogue.content: お仕事はどちらで探されていますか？
dialogue.English: Where have you been looking for jobs?

dialogue.content: ネットやハローワークです
dialogue.English: Online and at Hello Work.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ハローワークでは担当者の方に相談されましたでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Have you spoken with a representative at Hello Work?

dialogue.content: はいしました
dialogue.English: Yes, I have.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねどのようなお話をされましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. What did you discuss?

dialogue.content: 担当の人は今は若い人もかなり仕事探しているので応募要件にあっても年齢が難しいのかもって言ってました
dialogue.English: The representative said that since many young people are also looking for work right now, my age might be a hurdle, even if I meet the application requirements.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: Is that what they said?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そう言われたときどう思いましたか？
dialogue.English: How did you feel when they said that?

dialogue.content: 年齢は変えられないのでなんとも(笑)
dialogue.English: Well, I can't change my age, so there's not much I can do. (laughs)

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、年齢のことを言っていられない人手不足の業種もあると思いますので
dialogue.English: However, I believe there are industries with such labor shortages that they can't afford to be concerned about age.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: どうやって、あなたとマッチングする所を見つけていくかですよね
dialogue.English: The key is to find a way to match you with the right place, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい　そうですね！
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly!

dialogue.content: ハローワークの方のお話で、何かヒントになりそうなことはありませんでしたか？
dialogue.English: Was there anything the person at Hello Work said that might have been a helpful hint?

dialogue.content: 特には感じなかったですね、みんな忙しそうで、はい次、はい次みたいな感じでした
dialogue.English: Not really. Everyone seemed busy, and it had a 'next, please' kind of atmosphere.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですか
dialogue.English: Oh, is that how it was?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちょっとがっかりしますよね
dialogue.English: That's a bit disheartening, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。頼りにならなくて
dialogue.English: Exactly. They weren't very helpful.

dialogue.content: いいアドバイスをもらえないとそう感じてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel that way when you don't receive helpful advice.

dialogue.content: はい　そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 民間の転職紹介機関には行かれたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you tried any private recruitment agencies?

dialogue.content: はい　派遣にもとうろくはしています
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm also registered with some temp agencies.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そこでは、どんな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What has your experience been like there?

dialogue.content: とりあえず書類預かりましょう、何かあったら連絡しますという感じです
dialogue.English: It's mostly a case of, 'We'll hold onto your documents and contact you if something comes up.'

dialogue.content: そこでも、あまり相談に乗ってもらえなかったんですね
dialogue.English: So you didn't get much personalized consultation there either, I see.

dialogue.content: はい　そんな感じでした
dialogue.English: Yes, that's the feeling I got.

dialogue.content: なかなか相談にのってもらえず、もどかしいですね
dialogue.English: It must be frustrating not being able to get the support you need.

dialogue.content: はい　本当に、困っちゃいます
dialogue.English: Yes, it really is. I'm at a loss.

dialogue.content: そうですよね困ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It's a very difficult situation.

dialogue.content: ところで、あなたはどんなお仕事を探されていますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, what kind of work are you looking for?

dialogue.content: とりあえず夜勤がなくて立ち仕事でないものです
dialogue.English: For now, something without night shifts that doesn't require me to be on my feet all day.

dialogue.content: 身体に負担がかからないお仕事がいいですよね
dialogue.English: A job that doesn't put a strain on your body would be ideal, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: ええ　年齢が年齢なので
dialogue.English: Yes, considering my age.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That makes sense.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お給料とかには拘りがありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any particular preferences regarding salary?

dialogue.content: いいえ、特には
dialogue.English: No, not particularly.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: これまでのお話を整理させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい　お願いいたします
dialogue.English: Yes, please do.

dialogue.content: あなたは以前夜勤のある仕事をしていて体調を崩してしまった
dialogue.English: You were previously working a job with night shifts, and your health suffered as a result.

dialogue.content: そのため転職することにしたが、履歴書を送っても、面接まではいかない
dialogue.English: Because of that, you decided to change jobs, but even when you send your resume, you aren't getting interviews.

dialogue.content: はいそんあかんじです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's about right.

dialogue.content: ハローワークの人には、年齢がネックなっているかもしれないと言われた
dialogue.English: At Hello Work, you were told that your age might be a barrier.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ハローワークでも、人材派遣会社でも、あまり相談に乗ってもらえず、どうしたらいいのかわからない
dialogue.English: You haven't received much consultation at either Hello Work or the temp agencies, so you're not sure what to do.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ということなのですね
dialogue.English: Is that an accurate summary of the situation?

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 転職先がなかなか見つからず、年齢のこともあって、焦ってしまうのはもっともなことだと思います
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable that you'd feel anxious, given the trouble you're having finding a new job and your concerns about age.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes... thank you.

dialogue.content: でも、そんな中であなたはこれまで、あなたにできる努力をされてきたんだと思います
dialogue.English: But even in this situation, I believe you have been making every effort you can.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 運はいつ開けるかは予測がつきませんが、ご自分にできることをやっていくことがとても大切なことだと思います
dialogue.English: We can't predict when your luck will turn, but I think it's very important to keep doing what's within your control.

dialogue.content: はいわかりました、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 実は私も以前会社を辞めたくなったことがあったんです
dialogue.English: Actually, there was a time when I also wanted to quit my job.

dialogue.content: (ごめんなさい🙏🏻終了時間オバーしてます。仕事に戻らなくてはなりません)
dialogue.English: (I'm so sorry, we're over our scheduled time. I have to get back to work.)

dialogue.content: それで、いろいろな転職斡旋機関に相談に行ってみたのですが、
dialogue.English: So, I went to various job placement agencies for advice, and...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 中にはじっくり相談に乗ってくれるところもありました
dialogue.English: Some of them were willing to take the time to listen carefully and offer thorough advice.

dialogue.content: わかりました、そういうところ見つけてみますね！
dialogue.English: I understand. I'll try to find a place like that!

dialogue.content: （途中ですが、時間オーバーしているので、ここまでとしますね）
dialogue.English: (I know we're in the middle of our conversation, but since we're over time, let's stop here for today.)

dialogue.content: (はい　すみません。よろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.English: (Yes, I'm sorry about that. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: （厳しいコメントを歓迎していますので、よろしくお願いします）
dialogue.English: (I welcome candid feedback, so please don't hold back.)

dialogue.content: （それでは終了しますね）
dialogue.English: (Alright, I'll end the session now.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました😊)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much! 😊)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
